app.name: Karpo
app.loadError: The application configuration could not be loaded.
app.contextError: Your permissions could not be loaded: something may be missing from the menu.

home.title: Home
home.body: Pick an option from the menu or press Ctrl+K to jump straight to what you need.
home.empty: You have no screens available yet. Ask your administrator for permissions.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: Your user is not allowed to see this screen.
forbidden.entity: Your user is not allowed to see “{{name}}”.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address does not exist or is no longer available.

listForbidden.title: You are not allowed to see this list.
listForbidden.body: If you think this is a mistake, ask your administrator for access.

theme.label: Theme
theme.error: Could not switch to the “{{name}}” theme.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a command or the name of a screen…

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Each screen's shortcuts appear while it is open.

menu.title: Menu
menu.body: These are the screens you can reach. Collapse the groups and, if needed, type in the search box to find one.

search.title: Menu search
search.body: Type part of a screen's name; Enter opens the first match and the down arrow walks through the rest.

view-switch.title: Switch view
view-switch.body: One control to see the same data as a table, tree, diagram or map, depending on what the screen supports. Your choice is kept in the address, so it can be shared.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.body: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on a Mac) to find screens, create records, run commands on what is selected or change theme, mode and language.

user.title: Your user
user.body: Change your password, look up the keyboard shortcuts or sign out.

new.title: New record
new.body: Creates a new record on this screen. You can also press N at any time outside a text field.

more.title: More options
more.body: On narrow screens this is where the theme, colour mode, language, shortcuts, password change and sign out live.
